note: Legacy ISO subdivision nodes are re-ided to fr-region/fr-department/fr-commune ids through the fixed official ISO↔INSEE correspondence (method recorded per row); FR-69M (Métropole de Lyon, CTCD tier) has no profile counterpart and stays legacy with an unmapped record. COMD/COMA absorbed communes carry the COMPARENT successor (commune nouvelle codes may reuse the seat code); ARM and non-COM overseas zonages are per-row excluded records. Per the plan name rule no legacy names are inherited on re-id — new ids carry source-native French names and other locales stay missing.
